description:
Create a 3D elevation path for a hiking trail by draping a 2D line over a Digital Elevation Model (DEM).

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the elevation raster: /home/ga/GIS_Data/srtm_41_19.tif (SRTM data for Western Cape, South Africa).
3. Load the 2D trail vector: /home/ga/GIS_Data/proposed_trail_2d.geojson.
4. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox) and find the 'Drape (set Z value from raster)' algorithm under Vector geometry.
5. Run the Drape tool:
   - Input layer: proposed_trail_2d
   - Raster layer: srtm_41_19
   - Band number: 1
6. Save the output as a GeoPackage file to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/trail_3d.gpkg. Ensure the geometry type includes Z values.
7. Verify the new layer has valid elevation data (not 0) on its vertices.
